description: Generate video from a text prompt with the Cosmos 3 Nano (16B) omni model.
inputInstructions:
Generates a video from a text prompt using Cosmos3-Nano. No input file is required — the prompt is the input.

Asset metadata this pipeline reads (all optional):
  COSMOS3_PROMPT           What to generate. Falls back to this when the Prompt field is blank.
  COSMOS3_NEGATIVE_PROMPT  What to avoid in the output.
  COSMOS3_SEED             Integer seed; the same seed reproduces the same generation.
  COSMOS3_GUIDANCE         How strictly to follow the prompt.
  COSMOS3_NUM_FRAMES       Number of frames to generate. Falls back to this when the Frames to generate field is blank.
  COSMOS3_TASK_MODE        Generation mode, where the pipeline variant supports more than one.
  COSMOS3_CONTROL_TYPE     Control-signal type (control-conditioned modes).
  COSMOS3_CONTROL_PATH     Asset-relative path to the control input.
  COSMOS3_CONTROL_WEIGHT   How strongly the control signal is applied.
  COSMOS3_CONTROL_GUIDANCE Guidance applied to the control signal.

How to supply metadata: set these as metadata on the ASSET (Metadata tab on the asset page, or `vamscli metadata create`). Keys are case-sensitive.

Precedence: a value you type into a field above WINS. Asset metadata is used only where the field is left blank, so a standing value on the asset acts as a per-asset default.

Content safety: Disable content-safety guardrails ships CHECKED, so the NVIDIA guardrail models are skipped. They load alongside the generation model and need more GPU memory than the shipped instance types provide, so they are off by default for capacity reasons. Clear the field to run them, after raising the pipeline's instanceTypes to a larger GPU tier.

tagSchema.label: Prompt
tagSchema.description: The generation prompt. Leave blank to fall back to the COSMOS3_PROMPT asset metadata key.

tagSchema.label: Negative prompt
tagSchema.description: What to avoid in the generation. Blank falls back to COSMOS3_NEGATIVE_PROMPT asset metadata.

tagSchema.label: Frames to generate
tagSchema.description: Video length in frames at 24 fps, so 93 is about 3.9 seconds. Longer sequences need more GPU memory than the model weights leave free, and a value the reserved GPUs cannot hold fails during generation rather than at launch — raise it in steps and keep to a multiple of four plus one (93, 121, 189). Blank falls back to COSMOS3_NUM_FRAMES asset metadata.

tagSchema.label: Disable content-safety guardrails
tagSchema.description: Checked by default, which skips the NVIDIA guardrail models. They load alongside the generation model and need more GPU memory than the shipped instance types provide, so guardrails ship off for capacity reasons. Clear this to run them, after raising the pipeline's instanceTypes to a larger GPU tier.
